newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Lain to start Pacsa merger - CNMV.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Lain to start Pacsa merger - CNMV.

text.p: Spain's Construcciones Lain construction group is starting its merger with Peninsular de Asfaltos y Construcciones (Pacsa), the Stock market Commission CNMV said on Friday.

"The board of Construcciones Lain S.A. in its July 31 meeting and the sole administrator of Peninsular de Asfaltos y Contrucciones agreed formally to start the process of merging the two groups," Lain told the CNMV in a statement.
The merger must be approved by shareholders' meetings on December 31.
According to the deal, Pacsa shareholders will receive 14 shares of Construcciones Lain at a nominal value of 100 pesetas for each 15 shares in Lain, at 1,000 pesetas nominal value.
This exchange is based on a valuation of Lain of 29.47 billion pesetas, or 307 pesetas a share and of 1.81 billion, or 286 pesetas a share, for Pacsa.
As a result of the deal, Lain will raise capital throught the issue of up to 5.91 million shares to complete the exchange with Pacsa.
